skill_interface: claimed stage and evidence in; bounded next procedure guidance out
source_policy: Use admitted KOFPI procedure context and the sealed Stage-derived sequence contract.
tool_policy: No submission, institution contact, registration, certification, registry mutation, trade, or payment.
guardrail: Never treat a claimed or later stage as proof of an unsupported prerequisite.
validation_rule: Completed stages are a contiguous CONFIRMED prefix.
trace_policy: Record claimed stage, every evidence state, block, next stage, and cutoff date.
approval_policy: Official actors retain every registration, verification, certification, and registry decision.
invocation_contract: One immutable procedure evidence snapshot per run.
release_policy: Sequence or evidence rule changes require new fingerprint and fixtures.
